selection.algorithm: minimum and maximum MACs, then greedy max-min squared Euclidean distance; lexical ID tie break
selection.normalization: min-max over public features of the locked 15

target.runtime: TFLite Micro + ESP-NN; Flash weights; PSRAM tensor arena
target.scope: standalone inference harness; full board application integration unverified

unchanged_gates.note: internal heap is incremental, not total SRAM; image test results never reselect the pool

raw_macs.output: ranking only; no millisecond error metrics

ridge_specification.scaler: mean and population standard deviation fitted on six support rows only; zero std -> 1
ridge_specification.support_diagnostic: leave-one-out with scaler refit inside each fold; not held-out-nine evidence

memory_and_storage.psram_calibration: max(0, QEMU_peak + median(real_peak-QEMU_peak on same six supports))
memory_and_storage.internal_heap_baseline: existing QEMU incremental internal heap peak bytes
memory_and_storage.internal_heap_calibration: same median residual offset, clipped at zero
memory_and_storage.storage: exact production .tflite file bytes; no learned size predictor
memory_and_storage.firmware_flash: report linked production image and partitions separately; exclude diagnostic golden payloads
memory_and_storage.additional_system_memory: record static DRAM/IRAM, reserved stacks and high-water marks, baseline/minimum free heap and largest blocks separately
memory_and_storage.uncertainty: no claimed confidence bound from six architectures; point estimates and support residuals only

future_measurement.input: same existing 102 class-stratified validation inputs, batch 1, 160x160, integer input
future_measurement.input_order: seed 20261028 + session_index (0,1,2); one permutation per session repeated twice, identical across networks
future_measurement.timer: esp_timer_get_time around Invoke only; exclude preprocessing, input copies and serial output
future_measurement.latency_label: median of three per-session median latency_ms
future_measurement.execution: fixed CPU 240 MHz and PSRAM 80 MHz; pin inference to core 1; disable DFS/light sleep/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth; other core idle except required OS tasks
future_measurement.memory_pass: separate from timed pass; local minimum-free heap monitor spans arena allocation, AllocateTensors and Invoke; log after interval
future_measurement.arena: direct allocation of frozen arena_used_bytes rounded to 16-byte alignment plus 4096-byte headroom; exclude old 6 MiB probe from production measurement
future_measurement.memory_label: maximum model-related peak delta over three independent memory sessions; SPIRAM and INTERNAL|8BIT separately
future_measurement.required_before_board: implement timing harness and revalidate all 15 in host/QEMU with unchanged model hashes; pin firmware/model/sdkconfig/compiler/TFLM/ESP-NN hashes and clock/cache settings
future_measurement.failure: retain failed network ID and record failure/infeasibility; no silent replacement, imputed labels, or query measurement for training

lock_sequence: Current: freeze fifteen model identities, label-free six/nine split and analysis protocol; no physical board access.
Future after board-stage authorization: collect real labels for exactly the six support architectures.
Fit fixed models; save scaler/coefficients, all nine predictions, support-only derived budgets and all decisions with SHA256 and timestamp.
Only after prediction lock, optionally measure nine query networks as independent evaluation; never refit or select methods using their labels.

evaluation.latency_primary: MAPE over nine query architectures; each architecture equal weight
latency_secondary: median and maximum absolute percentage error
Spearman rank correlation with average ranks
pairwise ordering agreement; predicted ties receive 0.5, oracle ties excluded
evaluation.zero_memory_labels: percentage errors undefined for zero; report NA, never epsilon-denominator MAPE
evaluation.decision_pool: nine held-out networks; original INT8 validation accuracy and unchanged memory/storage gates
evaluation.primary_decision: predict fastest feasible query network; ID breaks equal predicted latencies
evaluation.latency_regret: (actual chosen latency - actual oracle minimum feasible latency) / oracle minimum feasible latency
evaluation.secondary_decision: maximize original INT8 validation accuracy under latency budgets; ties: lower predicted latency then lexical ID
evaluation.latency_budgets: 0.75, 1.0, 1.25 times median of six support latency labels; freeze before any query reveal; sensitivity analysis, not application SLA
evaluation.accuracy_regret: oracle maximum feasible validation accuracy minus chosen validation accuracy, in percentage points
evaluation.invalid_decision: chosen infeasible -> failure and budget violation, regret NA; no feasible oracle or no selected model -> explicitly report NA/no selection
evaluation.oracle: all measured query labels, evaluation only; never a six-label deployable method
evaluation.six_only_limit: with only six real measurements there is no measured nine-query error, rank correlation or regret; show unverified predictions and support LOOCV only
evaluation.budget_claim: calibration/decision uses 6 rather than 15 distinct networks: 60% fewer; a complete independent 9-query audit makes total experimental measurements 15, not 6
evaluation.honesty: no guaranteed improvement; report if same-budget MAC-only baselines match or beat structure Ridge

interpretation: few-shot device-specific calibration, not meta-learning from six samples; existing MCU NAS already includes memory/runtime constraints
